segments.name: Community Banking
segments.description: Accepts deposits and originates commercial and consumer loans for personal and business customers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates through a single operating and reporting segment, Community Banking that offers services which include accepting a full range of deposit products and originating commercial and consumer loans.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay interest on loans and securities and fees for financial services, which generate the Bank's revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: As a state-chartered commercial bank and state member of the FRB, the Bank earns revenue primarily from interest on loans and securities and fees charged for financial services provided to customers.
